personality: 7 Dark-First Utility fused with Glassmorphic Neon accents
personality_one_liner: A dark, neon-accented, glassmorphic safety command center that feels instantly responsive and highly secure.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing on glass cards, tight grouping on metrics.

do's: Use on bottom tabs, floating header, cards over map, auth cards
dont's: Don't use on standard text inputs or dense lists

screens.name: Auth
screens.layout: Full screen abstract dark neon background image. A centered glassmorphic card (surfaceSecondary + blur) contains inputs and Primary cyan CTA button. Typography uses Chakra Petch for headings.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Quick access to SOS and top-level stats
screens.layout: Header with user greeting. Center of screen: Huge circular pulsing red SOS button (shadow/glow effects using Reanimated). Below button: Glass grid cards for quick stats (Alerts, Active Safe Zones).

screens.name: Family

states.empty: No family members - prompt to join via code

screens.layout: Full-bleed react-native-maps. Top floating glass header for map controls. Bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) displaying list of members (name, battery icon, last-seen, purple accent).

screens.name: Security
screens.purpose: Manage Anti-theft devices and Smart QR tags
screens.layout: Segmented control at top (Anti-theft / Smart QR). Anti-theft: Lock/Siren toggle cards (red accent). QR: List of tags/vehicles with mini QR thumbnail (teal accent).

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Cover banner at top. User details. Standard list rows (surfaceSecondary, margin md) for notification settings, emergency contacts CRUD, logout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color mappings provided: Cyan (#22d3ee) for Personal Safety/Primary, Purple (#8b5cf6) for Family, Red (#ff3b5c) for SOS/Anti-theft, Teal (#2dd4bf) for Smart QR.
Typography: Use 'Chakra Petch' (Google Fonts) for display/headings and 'Outfit' (or inter/sans) for body.
Ensure 'GlassCard' component uses 'expo-blur' (or 'expo-glass-effect' on iOS) with surfaceSecondary and 1px borderStrong outline with partial opacity.
The Home screen SOS button MUST be a large circular element using react-native-reanimated to create a pulsing/glowing alarm ring effect in the red (#ff3b5c) accent.
Implement 'Chip' component as small pill tags with translucent tinted backgrounds matching the pillar color.
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the Family map screen to overlay the member list on top of react-native-maps.
Buttons should have two variants: 'btn-primary' (solid/gradient cyan) and 'btn-ghost' (translucent bordered).
Iconography MUST use Feather icons (lucide-style line icons).
